entities.name: Query PKS-like protein
observations: 768-aa sequence contains ketoacyl-synthase (PF00109/PF02801) and acyltransferase (PF00698) domain matches.
Aligns to reviewed Aspergillus terreus hybrid PKS-NRPS PytA (Q0CZH1) at 33.8% identity, 80.3% query coverage, E-value 1.85e-103.
Evidence favors a polyketide synthase acyl-chain extension function; the query's detected domains do not establish a complete NRPS module, exact product, or pathway.

entities.name: PytA Q0CZH1
observations: Reviewed Aspergillus terreus hybrid PKS-NRPS synthetase involved in pyranterreone biosynthesis; reported to extend an acetyl starter using malonyl-CoA and connect the acyl chain to L-serine.
